pages.text: Charged Porters are portable teleportation tools that use $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_receiver)Matter Receivers$(/l) as destinations. They must be charged with FE before use.

pages.title: Targets
pages.text: Right-click a porter on a Matter Receiver to store that destination. The basic porter stores one target; the advanced porter can store multiple targets and cycle between them.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: Use the charged porter to start teleporting. The receiver must still exist and be usable. The advanced porter is better for players who travel between several bases.

pages.title: Teleport Probe
pages.text: The Teleport Probe helps inspect receiver information and porter targets, which is useful when debugging a larger teleporter network.
